web-guide-idea-111.audience: People interested in practical travel routines.
web-guide-idea-111.offer: Share campsite cooking, organising or route reflections while safely parked. Everyday travel life can be the focus without broadcasting your precise current location.
web-guide-idea-111.steps.1: Introduce the routine and explain one practical lesson.
web-guide-idea-111.steps.2: Answer questions and finish before driving.
web-guide-idea-111.equipment: A phone, power bank and stable mount or stand. Test connection at the stop.
web-guide-idea-111.returnReason: Follow different stops and the routines that make travel workable.
web-guide-idea-111.promotion: Post a general setting and session theme, avoiding a live location that compromises privacy.
